Hi Priya (and Tom) — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and what we can provide this week: 

1) Breach notification windows
- Internal detection/triage: typically within 24 hours of detection.
- External notification: Redwood’s typical contractual language is notification of confirmed data breaches affecting customer data within 72 hours of confirmation (we can commit to 72 hours for critical incidents; lower windows can be discussed for high-risk data classes).

2) BCP/DR artifacts
- We can provide: (a) redacted DR runbook sample, (b) summary of last three DR exercises (dates and scope), (c) RTO/RPO guidance per deployment mode.
- Format: we’ll zip artifacts into BCP-DR-sample-artifacts.zip and upload to the shared Drive link.

3) SOC 2 / evidence
- Current status: SOC 2 Type II in progress; we have a recent Type I and interim evidence we can share. The SOC2-typeII-summary.pdf covers scope and expected delivery window.

4) HIPAA / BAA
- We support BAAs for customers who require them. For PHI workloads we recommend Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for strongest isolation; Dedicated customers can be scoped depending on controls and contractual terms. We’ll flag any configuration requirements in the questionnaire responses.

Next steps and timeline
- We will: (A) fill the CrestPoint questionnaire with redacted artifacts where needed, (B) upload the BCP/DR ZIP and SOC interim evidence to the Drive folder, (C) propose contract language for the incident-notification section for your Legal to review.
- Target turnaround: 7 business days for a completed questionnaire + artifacts to meet your 10-business-day window. If you want some items sooner (e.g., SOC interim evidence first), we can prioritize.

Attachments we will upload: vendor_questionnaire_CrestPoint_filled.pdf (completed answers), BCP-DR-sample-artifacts.zip, SOC2-typeII-summary.pdf

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call today at 4pm PT to walk through critical questions.

Thanks,
